dataset: IEEE Signal Processing Cup 2015 public training set
truth: Supplied BPM0 arrays; exact equality checked against archived experiment truth
estimator_inputs: Two wrist PPG channels and three-axis accelerometer; no ECG/truth passed to estimator
missing_policy: Initialization NaNs excluded from MAE; counts and availability disclosed separately

paper_reference.comparison: Reference only; different input count, implementation, initialization and selection protocol

threshold_only_loso.selection: One final scalar selected by minimum 11-subject macro MAE from a predeclared 8-value grid; parameters withheld
threshold_only_loso.limitation: Not full-pipeline held-out validation; prior design and hyperparameters used all subjects

limitations: Development and selection used the same 12 training recordings; no independent dataset validation
Improved result uses a second PPG channel unlike the single-channel paper experiment
Implementation differs from author code; original author implementation was not rerun
One or more initialization windows may have no output; see exact counts
Forward-backward filtering of whole-record arbiter signals uses future samples; not a strict causal streaming implementation
Runtime is workstation evidence only, not an embedded-power or latency benchmark
Oracle results are not deployable estimates and are excluded from public performance tables
Aggregate recomputation validates arithmetic, not an independent reproduction of the private estimator
Rights, dataset redistribution permission and employer-IP clearance require owner review before publication
